display_name_en: Gov Doc to PPT & Official Document
description_zh: 将政务素材（政策文件、讲话稿、工作总结、调研报告、党建材料）智能提炼为规范的汇报 PPT，并可附带生成 GB/T 9704 标准的红头公文 Word 文档（通知/报告/请示）。内置党政红头配色方案和 6 大汇报场景模板（述职报告、工作总结、领导讲话、政策解读、调研汇报、党建汇报）。适用于政府/事业单位工作人员及为政府提供咨询服务的乙方公司。
description_en: Summarize government documents, leadership speeches, work reports, and policy papers into professional presentation slides. Also generates GB/T 9704 standard official documents (notices, reports, requests) with proper formatting. Includes government-specific color palettes and 6 presentation scene templates. Suitable for government staff and consulting firms.
examples_zh: 帮我把这份领导讲话稿做成汇报 PPT，用红头风格
把这份调研报告提炼成 15 页演示文稿，并生成一份红头文件
这是一份年度工作总结，请帮我生成党建工作汇报 PPT
把这份政策文件的核心要点提炼出来，做成 PPT 并附带公文简报
examples_en: Turn this leadership speech into a government-style presentation with red-header colors
Summarize this investigation report into 15 slides and generate an official document
Convert this annual work summary into a party-building report PPT
Extract key points from this policy document into slides and a briefing document

pricing.description_zh: 按次计费，每次调用生成完整 PPT + 可选红头公文
pricing.description_en: Pay-per-use: each invocation generates a complete PPT + optional official document
